conditions: the laptop on AC with its batteries neither charging nor discharging (00:48-00:53 on 2026-10-06: BAT0 'Not charging' at 99 %, BAT1 0 % 'Not charging', both power_now 0): the outlet reads the laptop's own draw only while no battery charges, which the scorer checks throughout. POWER PATH (sysfs, 00:50): the laptop's only power input is a USB-C port (UCSI USBC000:002, USB PD, the source offers 20 V / 2.75 A max) whose partner also holds the DisplayPort alt mode (DP-2) that drives the external monitor (Gigabyte GS27QCA, by its EDID); a Genesys Logic USB hub (05e3:0610 / 05e3:0625) carries the USB microphone and the keyboard. What feeds that USB-C link is not visible from the laptop: if it is a hub or dock fed by the laptop's charger on outlet 1, outlet 1's figure also holds that hub or dock and its USB devices (energy.md's wiring plan says only 'the laptop and its charger'); the user is asked to confirm. Constant extras cancel in the net figures, not in the gross ones. The internal panel (eDP-1) is off and the external monitor on throughout (GNOME idle-delay 0 and idle-dim off: it never blanks), so the display state is the same in the idle and the load windows. Idle sleep on AC 'nothing'; the lid stays open (lid close on AC = suspend). Power profile 'performance' (intel_pstate, governor powersave, turbo on); integrated GPU only (UHD 620). Running: GNOME Shell, the Claude desktop app that runs this session, and LINE under Wine (winedevice.exe ~1.7 % CPU). The user closed Discord, LibreOffice, the Zen browser and VS Code before registration (load average 0.5, x86_pkg_temp 51-53 C at 00:49-00:53). The session makes no tool calls while a laptop run is in progress (its own activity lands in outlet 1). systemd timers that may fire during the chain were left as they are (sysstat-collect every 10 min; fwupd-refresh ~01:25; man-db ~01:29). Each run starts once x86_pkg_temp reads below 55 C (run_laptop_chain.sh: polled every 5 s, at most 20 min, the wait logged). A SHAKEDOWN ran before this registration: 23:05 on 2026-10-05, q4km, one cycle at pp 512:3 / tg 128:3 (-r 2 was first refused by the runner's house rule), under a scratch registration with these same predictions, written at 23:05:08 before it ran (kept with its scores in .handoff/assets/energy-2026-10-05/laptop_shakedown/). It measured pp 48.3 t/s and tg 20.4 t/s (both below their bands), idle 31.1 W, the package up to 78 C, with Discord and LibreOffice open (and the Zen browser and VS Code, still running after it). No band was changed after it; the apps were closed instead. Runs only after the pooled-energy session and the Jetson CPU redo have ended, one strip logger at a time.
